query:
SELECT 
    title,
    propertyType,
    district,
    price,
    currency,
    bedrooms,
    bathrooms,
    area,
    ownerPhone,
    ownerWhatsapp,
    ownerEmail,
    sourceUrl,
    portal
FROM properties
WHERE 
    operationType = 'venta'
    AND propertyType LIKE '%casa%'
    AND (district LIKE '%Pueblo Libre%' OR district LIKE '%Surco%')
    AND currency = 'USD'
    AND price BETWEEN 300000 AND 1300000
ORDER BY createdAt DESC
LIMIT 20;
